invariant: One immutable client independence preview and exact rule/service-epoch proofs; it never grants production acceptance. The evaluation records the rule-set version, every nonattest service considered, the result (compatible, conditionally_compatible or impaired), the partner evaluation reference when conditional, and the management acknowledgement reference (M0-D26 D26-06; Jev 0.55, moderate)
mustPreserve: Never reactivate a permanent independence commitment from reevaluation; acceptance binds exact service, draft, acknowledgement and ratified-rule proofs.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation: exact redelivery resolves the original result, a changed admission is a new identity

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Pure evaluation from complete frozen as-of source/rule/practice snapshots; no live source reads and no production acceptance authority.
selectedCommandContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant-scoped tenant / evaluationId; the identity is established by the admitting owner or reactor named in the choreography, never by a caller request key; mutations bind CommandId to this exact identity.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

invariantRevisions.added: The evaluation records the rule-set version, every nonattest service considered, the result (compatible, conditionally_compatible or impaired), the partner evaluation reference when conditional, and the management acknowledgement reference (M0-D26 D26-06; Jev 0.55, moderate)

commandNote: User command is admitted elsewhere; decision fact is process-materialized.

productRules.rule: An IndependenceEvaluation records the rule-set version, nonattest services considered, result (compatible, conditionally_compatible, or impaired), partner evaluation when conditional, management's acknowledgement of responsibility for nonattest services, and the approver and time.

decides: The evaluation is refused unless it records the rule-set version, every nonattest service considered, a result of compatible, conditionally_compatible or impaired, the approver and time, a partner evaluation reference when conditionally_compatible, and management's acknowledgement of responsibility for nonattest services.
